import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

# Get trips and check recent DAY_1_5 performance
trips = tables['trips']

# DAY_1_5 trips from last 14 days (d230-d244)
day15 = trips[(trips['cls'] == 'day_1_5') & (trips['fish_date_t'] >= 230)]
print("=== DAY_1_5 TRIPS (d230-d244, fish dates) ===")
if len(day15) > 0:
    day15_agg = day15.groupby('fish_date_doy').agg({
        'yt': 'sum',
        'anglers': 'sum',
        'boat': 'count'
    }).rename(columns={'boat': 'trips'})
    day15_agg['yt_per_angler'] = day15_agg['yt'] / day15_agg['anglers']
    print(day15_agg.sort_index(ascending=False).head(14))
    print(f"\nRecent average (last 7 days): {day15[day15['fish_date_t'] >= 237]['yt'].sum() / (day15[day15['fish_date_t'] >= 237]['anglers'].sum() or 1):.3f} yt/angler")
else:
    print("No DAY_1_5 trips yet in d230-d244")

# Check water temperature trend (Scripps Pier)
pier = tables['pier']
pier_recent = pier[pier['ts_t'] >= 230].copy()
pier_recent['temp_f'] = pier_recent['wtmp_c'] * 9/5 + 32

print("\n=== WATER TEMPERATURE (Scripps Pier, d230-d244) ===")
# Get daily maximum (midday readings)
pier_daily = pier_recent[pier_recent['ts_hour'].between(10, 16)]
pier_daily_stats = pier_daily.groupby('ts_doy').agg({'temp_f': ['min', 'mean', 'max']})
print(pier_daily_stats.tail(14).round(1))

# Ocean SST in zones (last observation)
ocean = tables['ocean']
ocean_recent = ocean[ocean['target_date_t'] >= 230]
print("\n=== OCEAN SST (d230+, last readings) ===")
ocean_latest = ocean_recent.sort_values('avail_t').drop_duplicates('zone', keep='last')
print(ocean_latest[['zone', 'target_date_doy', 'sst_f']].sort_values('sst_f', ascending=False).head(10))

# Upcoming schedule (next 14 days, d244-258)
schedule = tables['schedule']
sched_next = schedule[(schedule['fish_date_t'] >= 244) & (schedule['fish_date_t'] <= 258)]
print("\n=== SCHEDULE NEXT 14 DAYS (d244-d258 fish dates) ===")
sched_by_class = sched_next.groupby(['fish_date_doy', 'cls']).size().unstack(fill_value=0)
print(sched_by_class)
